main.summary: Provides administrative inspection and purge operations for publication recovery state.

method.name: InspectAsync
method.summary: Loads a read-only recovery footprint for a transfer session.
method.returns: The recovery footprint, or null when the session does not exist.

method.name: PurgeAsync
method.summary: Deletes a transfer session's staging artifacts and DataControl recovery state after validating the inspection freshness conditions.
method.param: Explicitly confirmed purge request containing expected session and optional journal state.
method.returns: The purge result, or null when the expected state no longer matches.

main.summary: Implements administrative publication recovery inspection and staging-only purge.
main.remarks: Inspection reports database-recorded state and does not verify external artifacts. Purge removes staging Blobs under the session's item-instance prefix and database recovery state; final published artifacts and catalog data are left untouched.

field.name: sessions
field.summary: Store used to load and conditionally purge transfer recovery state.

field.name: coordinator
field.summary: Coordinates exclusive mutations for the item and transfer session.

field.name: storage
field.summary: Provides storage operations for the selected tenant catalog.

field.name: dataConfigs
field.summary: Resolves configured tenant storage for trusted publication-recovery operations.

constructor.name: PublicationRecoveryAdminService
constructor.param: Store for loading and purging transfer recovery state.
Coordinates mutations for the transfer item and session.
Client used to resolve the configured catalog storage.

method.name: InspectAsync
method.summary: Loads and describes the recorded recovery state for a session.
method.returns: The recovery footprint, or null when the session does not exist.

method.name: PurgeAsync
method.summary: Deletes the session's item-instance-scoped staging prefix and database recovery state when the inspected state is still current.
method.remarks: The operation preserves final artifact Blobs and catalog data. A null result means the expected session, journal, or configured catalog state did not match.
method.param: Explicitly confirmed purge request with expected session state version and, when present, journal identity, phase, and update time.
method.returns: The purge result, or null when the expected state no longer matches.

method.name: LoadFootprintAsync
method.summary: Loads the recovery-state snapshot and builds its inspection footprint.
method.returns: The recovery footprint, or null when the session does not exist.

method.name: BuildFootprint
method.summary: Maps a persisted recovery snapshot to the admin-facing recovery footprint.
method.param: Consistent session, journal, range, and chunk snapshot.
method.returns: A footprint describing recorded staging references and final artifact candidates.
method.exception: The snapshot has no transfer session.

method.name: GetSessionCatalogName
method.summary: Reads the catalog name from the session manifest according to its transfer family.
method.param: Transfer session whose manifest supplies the catalog name.
method.returns: The manifest catalog name, or an empty string when it is unavailable.

method.name: ToArtifact
method.summary: Maps a persisted transfer Blob reference to an admin-facing recovery artifact.

method.name: SanitizeLastError
method.summary: Redacts credential-like values, bearer/JWT tokens, and URLs from a journal error string.
method.returns: Sanitized error text limited to 1024 characters, or the original null/whitespace value.

method.name: CredentialAssignmentRegex
method.summary: Gets the generated regex that redacts credential assignments such as account keys, passwords, and access tokens.

method.name: SasParameterRegex
method.summary: Gets the generated regex that redacts Azure SAS query parameter values.

method.name: BearerTokenRegex
method.summary: Gets the generated regex that redacts bearer-token values.

method.name: JwtTokenRegex
method.summary: Gets the generated regex that redacts JWT-shaped token values.

method.name: UrlRegex
method.summary: Gets the generated regex that redacts HTTP and HTTPS URLs.
